Two instruments, each a short python script run from the scratchpad: (1) every regex literal whose body holds a bare LF escape not preceded by an optional CR (18 hits; the same scan on the pre-fix iv-e-116 blob found its 2 anchors, so it can fire); (2) every includes/indexOf/lastIndexOf/startsWith/endsWith/toContain/toMatch/replace call whose first string argument holds an LF escape (5 hits). Each of the 23 hits was read in context.

list.why: strips the import from PrintEntry.tsx's text for the CONTROL arm; the old regex ended on a bare LF directly after a literal and matched nothing on CRLF text (bun -e: old on CRLF false, new on CRLF true, new on LF true)
